title: Spec v1.1 closes all critical findings; first photomatch on the organiser's drone photos
stages: Site ✔ (zoning, heritage, survey, geotech, trees, neighbours)
Design research ✔ (trends, visuals, boards, façades, costs)
Concept v1.1 ✔ (all critical items closed: parking 110 ≥ 106, cost 149.18 M incl. 5 %, PV 415 kWp, EP 28, trees 36/44 by M.06); Sejmik S-2 ►
Production ►: drawings → v1.1 (workflow ►); plans re-run after S-2; photomatch tests ✔; extra showcase renders (workflow ►)
Boards ►: Stage II 8/8 skeletons with true-scale drawings (vis pending); Stage I 2/2; tables F.15/F.14.B ✔ (draft)
Audit ►: completeness 25/44; structural & functional audit ►; jury later
notes: Revision v1.1 closed every critical finding with numerical proof: garage redesigned (−2 under the whole footprint except the bay at Maz. 19, −1 raised to 4.20 m, 16 two-level stackers) → 110 spaces vs 106 required; tower column lines moved out of the corridors (v 0 / 8.70 / 16.00 / 23.15).

Cost 142.08 M + 5 % contingency = 149.18 M PLN net (0.82 M below the cap — tight, honest). PV 415 kWp only with modules η ≥ 22.5 % (BIPV roofs 351 + segment wall 41 + canopy 13 + spandrels 11). Crown lamellas now tone-on-tone with a Fibonacci rhythm (no moiré from the bridge).

Decisions flagged for the structural/fire audit: sprinklers dropped (not mandatory), 0.60 m diaphragm walls with a deeper −2, generator and dry-cooler inside the segment, 0.60 m sills in the wing with fixed safety glass to 0.90.
Photomatch on the organiser's drone photos F.17.A/B works geometrically; the building still reads too bright and flat → tonal match, shadows and materials in the finals.
At the user's request a separate workflow composes 8 extra showcase views (4 photographer strategies → judges → render → critique → refine).
